request:
Within auto_ontology/server/, which immediate subfolders contain more than 1,000 lines of Python in total? Count every .py file anywhere inside the subfolder, including its test files and __init__.py; files directly in auto_ontology/server/ itself belong to no subfolder. Return the subfolder's repository-relative path (e.g. auto_ontology/server/chat) and its total line count.

Requested output columns: folder_path (string), total_lines (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This calculates the total Python line count for each immediate subfolder under auto_ontology/server/. It includes every matching .py file anywhere below that subfolder, including test files and __init__.py, while excluding Python files placed directly in auto_ontology/server/. Only subfolders whose summed line count is greater than 1,000 are returned, ordered by total lines from highest to lowest.
sql: SELECT folder_path, CAST(SUM(line_count) AS INTEGER) AS total_lines FROM (SELECT line_count, 'auto_ontology/server/' || regexp_extract(file_id, '^auto_ontology/server/([^/]+)/', 1) AS folder_path FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files WHERE file_id LIKE '%.py' AND regexp_matches(file_id, '^auto_ontology/server/[^/]+/')) AS py_files GROUP BY folder_path HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY total_lines DESC, folder_path ASC
